plans.idea: Faithful centered poster: the logo stays as a top masthead, and the headline and CTA sit together as one tight centred block in the glow, so the tall format reads top to bottom without the current dead gap between headline and CTA.
Lower-third editorial: the logo stays alone at the top over open atmospheric space, and a large two-line headline with the CTA right under it anchors the bottom, as a story-style poster does.

Message first with a brand sign-off: the headline leads in the upper third with the CTA directly beneath it, and the logo moves to the bottom centre as a closing signature, framing the glowing middle.
